title: The Queen Nobody Should Take
setup: Your bishop on f6 already bites at g7, and your rook on h3 is waiting on the h-file. Find the move that leaves Black no good answer.
hint: Two black pawns are the only shield. Ask what the g7 pawn would open if it ever had to capture something.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qh6}} gives no check and takes nothing, yet it threatens mate on g7 and mate on h7 at once, and no single black move stops both.

The queen stands where a pawn can take it, and {{gxh6}} is the worst reply of all: it empties the g-file, and {{Rg3#}} follows, with the bishop on f6 now covering both g7 and h8.
